statements.t: Li added , “Building on this foundation, including our recently completed art exhibition, we have begun generating revenue across art advisory, acquisition assistance, exhibition services, post-transaction support, and MCN brokerage services, and expect this momentum to continue.

While we see a substantial market opportunity in the MCN business, continued investment in sales and marketing, research and development, and customer support will be essential to further grow our international customer base.
By building long-term, meaningful relationships, we aim to help customers leverage our services to establish stronger connections in the global marketplace.
As they increasingly recognize the value we provide, we expect them to expand their usage and upgrade their service plans, driving revenue growth within our current customer base.

Our target clients are individuals or entities seeking to grow their online presence as influencers or content creators, enterprises requiring customized software solutions, art owners and institutions in need of phygital art advisory services, and participants in the music industry.
We expect to commence new revenue streams beginning in the fourth quarter of 2026, including art curation, auction services, and MCN brokerage services.
For the remainder of fiscal 2026, we expect selling and marketing expenses to fluctuate with sales levels because certain expenses, such as commissions, are determined based on revenue.
We are evaluating options related to our liquidity and will continue to monitor our costs in relation to our sales and adjust our cost structure accordingly.
Our condensed consolidated financial statements as of September 30, 2026 were prepared under the assumption that we will continue as a going concern.

However, substantial doubt exists about our ability to continue as a going concern, and we will require additional liquidity to continue operations during the 12 months following the date the condensed consolidated financial statements are issued.

We expect that the level and timing of our service revenues, the associated operating results, and the status of each of our business development and technology enhancement initiatives will significantly impact our cash management decisions.
We will continue to monitor costs in relation to sales and adjust our cost structure accordingly.
We cannot guarantee that such funding will be available in needed quantities or on terms favorable to us, if at all.

To support our strategic transition to SaaS solutions and the scaling of our AI-driven platform, management anticipates requiring approximately $10 million in total funding over the period from 2026 through 2028.

We plan to allocate (1) $4.0 million in 2026 to develop AI technology for content and build a fan community and membership system, (2) $3.0 million in 2027 to enhance our SaaS system and develop security features for other intellectual property protection technologies, and (3) $3.0 million in 2028 to advance AI media development and expand content creation capabilities.
